from pathlib import Path
pdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485477/attempts/121aa726ce1d47daa341412ab2c8dccb/system/state/workspace/programs')
pdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=pdir/'task-413ac87b.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    others = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 5)]
    if len(markers) < 2 or not others:
        return out
    # The marker embedded in the colored pattern is the source; the isolated one is the target.
    src = min(markers, key=lambda p: min(abs(p[0]-r) + abs(p[1]-c) for r, c in others))
    dst = next(p for p in markers if p != src)
    out[dst[0]][dst[1]] = 0
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != 0 and value != 5:
                rr, cc = dst[0] + r - src[0], dst[1] + c - src[1]
                if 0 <= rr < len(out) and 0 <= cc < len(out[rr]):
                    out[rr][cc] = value
    return out
'''
path.write_text(code)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog', path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
